title: senna caudata
intro: Senna caudata, commonly known as the desert senna, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that offers various health benefits, including the treatment of constipation, diarrhea, and digestive issues, due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna caudata include stimulating the intestines and promoting bowel movements, which can lead to relief from symptoms associated with constipation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin, chrysophanol, and emodin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
